scope: Qualifying locations, scales, degrees of freedom and observation densities match conditioned model traces on synthetic fixtures.
Known-circuit context coefficients match every tested wet/neutralisation combination.
Running-order and completion factors match the existing joint likelihood on synthetic fixtures.
Small running-panel order permutations and censored geometric probabilities normalize to their known totals.
Joint draw indices, shared teammate effects, elimination, extreme hazard logits, generated frequencies, field permutations, path prefixes and batch coverage are checked.
Invalid parameters and unresolved conditions cannot silently produce a prediction.
limitations: These are software and conditional generative-equivalence checks, not convergence, recovery or predictive-calibration evidence.
Future conditions, unseen outcome-circuit coefficients, missing qualifying/penalty policy, completion exposure, lapping, shortened races and classification conditioning remain unresolved.
The resource measurement uses synthetic parameters and a temporary receipt with an explicit fixture convergence field; it is not a successful MCMC fit.
Resource figures are local; intended-runner fitting, full refresh and deployment remain unverified.
Canonical equal-opportunity producer integration and independent predictive evidence remain incomplete.
